telemetry.officialManualObservation: Codex /status is the documented interactive source for current token usage and remaining context capacity; this agent surface exposes no callable /status operation, so exact used/remaining tokens are unavailable.

estimation.method: ceil(cumulative UTF-8 text bytes surfaced to or generated by the executor / 3), then add a 25 percent safety margin

reserve.formula: max(20 percent of exposed context capacity, 24000)

decisionRules.atOrBelowThirtyPercentButAboveReserve: start no major step unless its atomic completion plus checkpoint is proven affordable
decisionRules.atOrBelowReserve: finish active atomic capture/write then safe-pause
decisionRules.automaticCompactionOrStateLoss: finish active atomic operation then safe-pause

measurementCadence: before and after high-output evidence reads
writePolicy: append-only NDJSON ledger; never rewrite a prior measurement
